correctness.rationale: For all finite degrees and positive independent edge masses, the nodal Gram matrix has positive diagonal leaf block and Schur complement \(M/4\). Its inverse gives kernel \(\frac{4-6t+(-6+9t)s}{M}+\frac{3ts\delta_{ij}}{m_i}\). Pointwise convexity in output coordinate reduces \(L^\infty\) norm to vertices; exact affine absolute integrals yield center \(5/3\), leaf \(\frac{7+3q}{3(1+q)}\), and strict derivative \(-\frac{4}{3(1+q)^2}\). Explicit row-sign inputs attain maxima. Kernel mass one proves exact positivity defect, symmetry proves \(L^1\) duality. An independent fractions-based Gauss–Jordan and absolute integration checker passed 27,416 assertions on 382 stars, but general truth follows from algebra and convexity, not finite sampling.
